mapper.sql: id, complaint_no, owner_id, owner_name, phone, house_no, complaint_type, title, content, status, handler, reply, handle_time, create_time

where.if: AND (complaint_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO complaint (complaint_no, owner_id, owner_name, phone, house_no, complaint_type, title, content, status, handler, reply, handle_time, create_time) VALUES (#{complaintNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{phone}, #{houseNo}, IFNULL(#{complaintType}, 'OTHER'), #{title}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'PENDING'), #{handler}, #{reply}, #{handleTime}, IFNULL(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM complaint GROUP BY status
SELECT complaint_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM complaint GROUP BY complaint_type ORDER BY value DESC
